per_test_verdicts.recommended_fix_target: Ensure the site’s initial HTML/CSS is rendered in light mode by default and only switches after hydration if needed. On the hosting side, check whether the SSR/edge cache is serving a dark-mode version, whether a persisted theme cookie/localStorage value is being injected into the initial response, and whether any preloaded CSS or inline script applies a dark class before first paint. Potential fixes include defaulting the server-rendered theme to light, removing dark theme classes from the initial document render, deferring theme application until after the first paint, and purging/partitioning cached responses so dark-themed HTML is not reused for anonymous first visits.
